absolute_pos_embed_layer: Learned [max_seq, dim] bias added along the sequence axis after token embeddings (same last dim).
activation: Capture layer activations from the MLP for tensor analysis.
activation_layer: torch nonlinearity module (ReLU, GELU, …) between layers — not the analysis Activation node.
adam_optimizer: Adam optimizer for training the connected MLP.
adamw_optimizer: AdamW optimizer with decoupled weight decay.
advection_dataset: Constant-velocity advection on a periodic 2D grid; flattened trajectory windows.
afno_encoder_block_layer: AFNO atomic layer: one AFNO-lite encoder-style block (spectral + feedforward residuals).
afno_lite_spatiotemporal_model: AFNO-lite composite model: patchify + low-frequency spectral mixer + feedforward blocks over spatiotemporal tokens, then decode back to flat fields.
afno_patch_decode_layer: AFNO atomic layer: lightweight spatial decode/refinement on flattened field tensors.
afno_patch_embed_layer: AFNO atomic layer: patch embed and decode in flat field space. Use in input-output mode for custom AFNO chains.
afno_spectral_mixer_layer: AFNO atomic layer: low-frequency spectral mixing on flattened spatiotemporal fields.
attention_only_model: Multi-head self-attention on [batch, T, d] (causal or bidirectional); no embed/LM head.
basic_calculator: Combine N scalar tensors with a LaTeX formula (x_1, x_2, …) into one scalar output tensor.
bigram_low_rank_dataset: Bigram dataset with low-rank transition logits; sample x from stationary distribution then y from P(y|x).
binary_cross_entropy_with_logits_loss: Binary cross-entropy for a single-logit classifier. Targets must be integer class labels 0/1; the runtime converts them to floating point.
biography_lm_dataset: Synthetic biography / fact-sheet token LM with template vs shuffle vs noisy slots (Physics-of-LLM-style probe).
causal_mask: Apply a causal (triangular) mask before softmax in attention-style subgraphs.
cifar10_dataset: Official CIFAR-10 (32×32 RGB): bundled data/cifar10 or URL fallback; 10-class labels.
circle_random_walk_dataset: Bigram random walk on a circular vocabulary: from each token, move left/right with configurable bias.
circular_motion_dataset: Toy physics dataset for circular trajectories; emits interleaved x/y tokens with y shifted by +N.
cogs_dataset: Synthetic COGS-flavored seq2seq pairs (not the full EMNLP corpus).
combined_model: Saved combined subgraph from the library (same as Model list): expandable shell with inner layers.
crl_env_config: CRL navigation env preset (point U4 maze or Ant U4–style sizing; server-side sim).
crl_residual_mlp: Deep residual MLP for CRL actor and φ/ψ encoders (four Dense+LN+Swish stages per block).
crl_trainer: Contrastive RL (PyTorch): env, CRL residual MLP, optimizer, replay + InfoNCE + actor.
curve_annotator: Attach to Training or Observable viz; mirror plot and label x-ranges (plateau, spike, …).
cyclic_batch_schedule: Cyclic batch size (Jastrzębski Fig 1 left CBS). Wire to trainer **batch schedule** socket.
cyclic_lr_schedule: Cyclic learning rate (Jastrzębski Fig 1 left CLR). Wire to optimizer **lr schedule** socket.
derivative_curve: Compute 1st–5th finite-difference derivative on a rank-1 (1D) tensor, preview it, and pass it downstream as tensor.
deterministic_diffusion_sampler: DDIM-like sampler with a fixed seed; generated images persist as runtime data.
diagonal_ssm_token_model: Diagonal input-dependent SSM recurrence stacked with residuals; token LM.
diffusion_mse_loss: Loss socket for diffusion_score_model training (noise MSE inside trainer loop).
diffusion_pde_dataset: Synthetic 2D heat-equation fields: flattened space-time windows for MSE regression / MPP-style ViT.
diffusion_score_model: MLP εθ(x_t, t) for DDPM-style noise prediction on vectors; use with diffusion_mse_loss + vector datasets.
dimension_permutator: Reorder tensor dimensions by wiring in↔out dots (row-major); left and right sockets are both labeled tensor.
dyck_dataset: Balanced bracket strings as token ids (Dyck-style); cross-entropy LM probe.
effective_rank: Scalar effective rank (entropy over singular values) of an upstream matrix tensor.
einsum: Einstein summation / einsum equation on the tensor chain.
elementwise_transform: Apply a scalar rule f(x) to each tensor element (LaTeX-style rule, default x^2).
embedding_layer: torch.nn.Embedding: left tensor = index map (long at runtime; float batches are cast), right tensor = float vectors.
fake_tensor: Declare a shape/dtype and run Check to annotate tensor sizes on wires or mark nodes where static shape rules disagree.
flatten: Collapse tensor axes: optional dimension index to keep separate; empty/null flattens to a single axis (shape check).
formal_language_suite_dataset: Generators for a^n b^n, palindrome, parity, etc.; controlled formal languages.
gated_mlp_model: MLP with multiplicative gating per hidden block: act(Wg x) * (Wv x).
gaussian_blob_dataset: Synthetic toy: K class-specific 2D Gaussian blobs on a grid (K configurable), plus configurable per-image noise (no download).
hole_counting_dataset: Synthetic blob with k circular holes; classify k (0..max holes).
hyena_like_conv_model: Causal depthwise conv + gated FFN blocks; convolutional sequence LM.
idnns_initialization: Re-initialize every Linear layer with the released IDNNs convention: fan-in truncated-normal weights (two standard deviations) and zero biases.
image_dataset_displayer: Preview vision dataset rows (MNIST, Gaussian blob, shape world, hole counting): wire dataset → train/test split, index range, grid columns.
in_context_associative_recall_dataset: Associative recall sequences: key-value pairs plus a query key; target is the mapped value token.
information_bottleneck_dataset: Deterministically samples the locally bundled binary F/y table. The asset is SHA-256 verified at runtime; its external provenance and licence are unverified.
input_sampler: Samples N inputs from a wired random-input distribution and emits a sample tensor.
kan_model: Kolmogorov–Arnold network (pykan KAN) for regression with the MSE trainer.
kan_reg: pykan get_reg() regularization (λ and inner lamb_* coeffs) added to MSE for kan_model only; connect to Trainer observables.
keskar_c1_c2_cnn_model: Keskar C1/C2 CNN for 32×32 CIFAR-10; batch-size sharpness repro.
l1_reg: L1 weight regularization (loss scale × Σ|w|) added to the primary loss; wire to Trainer loss together with MSE or cross-entropy.
l2_projection: After each optimizer step, project trainable weights onto an L2 norm shell; wire to Trainer loss socket (does not add to loss).
l2_reg: L2 weight regularization (loss scale × Σw²) added to the primary loss; wire to Trainer loss together with MSE or cross-entropy.
layer_norm_layer: torch.nn.LayerNorm over the trailing normalized_shape dimensions.
linear_attention_model: ELU+1 causal linear attention LM bundle (optional DW conv mixing); last-token CE.
linear_dataset: Synthetic linear regression dataset feeding the MLP trainer.
linear_layer: torch.nn.Linear as a chainable layer; left tensor ← upstream, right tensor → next layer or trainer model socket.
listops_dataset: Toy [ MIN a b ] integer expressions; scalar target token.
local_mixing_layer: Causal depthwise conv + residual along sequence (Canon-lite); same last dim as upstream [..., T, C].
lr_schedule: Warmup steps, constant vs cosine decay, and cosine floor — wire to an optimizer’s **lr schedule** socket.
memorization_a_dataset: Memory 1 dataset A: continuous x, random class labels (cross-entropy memorization). Pairs with memorization B.
memorization_b_dataset: Memory 1 dataset B: random input class + random output class (one-hot x); cross-entropy only, vs continuous-x dataset A.
mnist_dataset: Official MNIST (28×28 grayscale): IDX download over HTTPS with local cache; 10-class labels.
model_checkpoint: Save or load model + optimizer state.
model_weight_tensors: Materialize all model parameters (named_parameters); wire tensor list into Tensor selector to pick one.
modular_addition_dataset: Grokking-style modular arithmetic: input tokens [a,b], label is (a + b) mod p.
moe_mlp_model: Mixture-of-experts MLP: softmax gate mixes K expert MLPs.
mpp_spatiotemporal_model: MPP-like ViT: patchify frames, Transformer over space-time tokens, unpatch; matches arXiv:2310.02994-style field normalization.
mse_loss: Mean squared error loss for regression.
multi_hop_fact_chain_dataset: Synthetic chained relational facts plus query segment; scales hops for multi-step retrieval pressure.
muon_optimizer: Muon-style optimizer with momentum for deeper-model experiments.
mup_initialization: μP-style weight init (Linear / Embedding / LayerNorm). Wire into a model’s initialization target before training.
mup_lr_schedule: μP Adam LR multipliers by parameter group (embed / hidden / output) — wire to the same **lr schedule** socket (Adam + supported models); combine with an lr_schedule node for warmup / cosine.
ngram_language_dataset: Random Markov order-n transitions (Dirichlet-smoothed rows); LM baseline.
numeric_transformer_model: Transformer encoder on numeric tensors [batch, T, D_in] → [batch, T, D_out]; default causal self-attention (optional full-context / bidirectional).
observable_accuracy: Classification accuracy (top-1) from trainer predictions versus target labels at each log step.
observable_activation_norm_mean: Mean L2 norm of hooked Linear/Conv outputs; global pooled or per activation-stats bucket (multi-curve).
observable_activation_outlier_ratio: max|act|/mean|act| in the same hook pass; global or per-bucket (multi-curve).
observable_activation_stats: Mean and std of Linear/Conv activations: global = equal average across layer buckets (.layers.0., …) vs other modules; or separate series per bucket.
observable_attention_entropy_mean: Mean entropy of attention rows; global = last layer, all layers = one curve per encoder layer (same cores as sink mass).
observable_attention_head_sink_max: Max over heads of mean attention to sink key; global vs per-layer series like sink mass.
observable_attention_map: Records every selected layer, batch, and head tuple at each logging step (at most 20 slices). Retains the newest 50 frames; maps larger than 25 by 25 are stored as their final 25 by 25 window.
observable_attention_max_weight_mean: Mean max softmax mass per query; global = last layer or all layers = per-layer curves.
observable_attention_position_bias_ratio: Early-key vs average-key mass ratio; global vs per-layer series.
observable_attention_relation_score: Scores selected full-map attention cells using safe query/key position and token predicates.
observable_bezier_mode_connectivity: Optimize a quadratic Bezier control point between two checkpoints, then compare its loss path to linear interpolation.
observable_capacity: Memorization capacity in bits: (log(V) - loss) * N / log(2).
observable_embedding_effective_rank: Effective rank of the token embedding (global) or max rank per encoder block .layers.i (all layers, multi-curve).
observable_embedding_feature_drift: 1 − cosine between successive embeddings (global) or between flattened weights per .layers.i (all layers).
observable_embedding_trajectory: Logs per-token embedding vectors over training for trajectory plotting.
observable_fourier_component: Projects a regression target and prediction onto a sin/cos basis at one input frequency.
observable_gradient_norm: Log L2 norm of gradients each step: global, per top-level name segment, or per-parameter tensor (capped). Optional normalization by √(parameter count).
observable_hessian_eigenvalues: Logs ranked Hessian eigenvalues of the training loss (second derivatives wrt parameters).
observable_information_plane: Binned I(X;T) / I(T;Y) trajectories. maxSamples bounds deterministic evaluation sampling and CPU transfer per log point; Trainer log frequency controls how often this work runs.
observable_last_layer_weight_norm: L2 norm of the last nn.Linear weight (classification layer); the Slingshot Effect signature signal.
observable_layer_spectral_norm: Logs one norm curve per Linear layer using a deterministic, RNG-neutral measurement.
observable_linear_interpolation_barrier: Evaluate train/test loss and accuracy along theta(alpha) between two model checkpoints.
observable_neuron_trajectory_2d: Records first hidden-layer weight rows wᵢ∈ℝ² at each log step (2D neuron positions for rich/lazy regime).
observable_relu_nonlinear_count: Count post-ReLU units that are on for some batch samples and off for others (per hidden layer).
observable_representation_alpha_req: Power-law decay exponent of a selected representation covariance spectrum.
observable_representation_rankme: Entropy effective rank of a selected representation's centered feature covariance.
observable_sink_attention_mass: Mean softmax attention to a chosen key index (sink); global = averaged over encoder layers, or one series per layer. Attention-only + transformer / numeric token paths.
observable_train_test_gap: Logs test loss minus train loss when a train/test split exists.
observable_user: User-defined scalar from tensor path (saved definitions).
observable_viz: Mirror for an observable wired to the trainer (auto-spawns when you connect observable → trainer).
observable_weight_displacement: Fractional parameter displacement ‖w(t)−w(0)‖_F / ‖w(0)‖_F from the first log snapshot.
observable_weight_l1: Log L1 norm of weights during training.
observable_weight_l2: Log L2 norm of weights each step: global, per top-level name segment, or per-parameter tensor (capped).
observable_weight_product_sv: Logs top-k singular values of the effective weight product W_eff = W_n … W_1 at each log step.
paper_classification_dataset: Dense toy tasks for Rank Collapse (fixed Figure-5 samples, scalable X=I_N orthogonal CE/MSE protocols, plus legacy repeated-prototype controls) and Slingshot (8-class noisy hypercube); no Grokking task is used.
parametric_path_sampler: Linear path w(α)=w_SB+α(w_LB−w_SB); eval loss/accuracy vs α.
pca: Principal component analysis on tensor batches.
pcfg_dataset: PCFG toy LM: binary-tree legacy mode or cfg_sentence (weighted rules + lexicon) → padded next-token windows.
phi1_style_dataset: phi-1–style mixed textbook/QA/code toy corpus LM (synthetic / optional URL).
random_input_distribution: Random x generator settings (base law + optional Gaussian jitter) for a teacher dataset.
rank_aligned_initialization: Balanced two-factor initialization. With orthogonal Figure-5 samples S=I it gives the paper condition F^T F = W W^T; on legacy repeated-sample datasets it only gives factor-Gram alignment. The frequency-structured basis is the verified N=60, C=4, d in {2, 3} geometric-frequency protocol. robust_v1 locks the searched input rotation angle/plane to 3.0/1 and output rotation angle/plane to 1.7/2. Both Linear biases are pinned to zero.
reaction_diffusion_dataset: Fisher–KPP reaction–diffusion on a periodic grid; paired targets one Euler step ahead.
relation_tuple_dataset: Synthetic relation triple or inverse-query sequences; next-token CE without real KG text.
reshape: Einops-style reshape rule string on the tensor chain (documentation / subgraph layout).
residual_ln_model: Composable residual model with Pre-LN/Post-LN mode and alpha-scaled FC2 blocks.
resnet_model: Small ResNet-style CNN for 1×H×W inputs; use with vision datasets + cross-entropy.
rms_norm_layer: LLaMA-style RMS normalization on the last tensor dimension (optional affine scale).
rotary_embed_layer: RoPE on the last (even) feature dimension along positions on axis -2; shape-preserving in the chain.
rwkv_time_mix_token_model: Gated time recurrence + gated FF (RWKV-flavored); token LM.
scan_dataset: SCAN-like command→action toy data; synthetic offline or optional tasks.txt download.
series_endpoint_gap: Scalar last−first gap for a rank-1 (1D) upstream tensor (endpoint change of the series).
sgd_optimizer: Stochastic gradient descent optimizer with momentum.
shape_checker: Attach to a node output and click Check shape to show the current tensor shape.
shape_world_dataset: 3-class synthetic geometry: square vs triangle vs circle on gray noise.
signsgd_optimizer: SignSGD optimizer that steps by gradient sign.
slot_attention_token_model: Slot attention over embeddings; pooled slots → logits (token LM).
small_inception_cifar_model: Small Inception used in Zhang et al.'s CIFAR experiments. It accepts the default 32×32 CIFAR inputs; use the CIFAR paper whitening preprocessing to match the paper's 28×28 protocol. 1,649,402 trainable parameters for 10 classes.
smoothing_curve: Apply Gaussian smoothing on a rank-1 (1D) tensor, preview the smoothed curve, and pass it downstream as tensor.
soap_optimizer: SOAP optimizer: Adam moments in Shampoo eigenspaces.
softmax: Softmax along a configurable dimension in the tensor chain.
statistics: Einstein / einsum subscripts on one tensor; choose mean, max, … for collapsed axes.
statistics2: Two tensors: NumPy-style einsum pair; dot or cosine over contracted indices.
svd: Full singular value decomposition (U, S, Vh); optional column mean removal.
sweep_data_table: Accumulate sweep runs in a table from a 0D tensor viz stream.
symbolic_func_dataset: LaTeX y(x) + numeric params → sampled (x, y) for the trainer (SymPy on server).
synthetic_playground_dataset: Preset synthetic streams (depo/brevo/mano/capo/lano-style axes) for controlled LM experiments.
table_viz: Line plot from a sweep data table (x-axis and legend here).
teacher_dataset: Regression pairs y = f_teacher(x): wire an MLP teacher + train/test sample tensors from input sampler nodes.
tensor_add: Two tensors: element-wise sum with NumPy-style broadcasting.
tensor_concat: Concatenate multiple tensors into one output tensor (configurable number of inputs).
tensor_constant: Configurable dense tensor (zeros, uniform [-1,1], or Gaussian); init seed for random fills; view values in parameters.
tensor_linspace: Creates a 1D tensor with evenly spaced points between start and end, either linearly or in log10 space.
tensor_reader: Connect a tensor and open View tensor values for nested JSON (read-only), like model parameters.
tensor_selector: Pick which tensor from upstream (activations, model weights, losses, …) to visualize or aggregate.
tensor_slicing: Slice one tensor dimension by selected indices. One index collapses that dimension; multiple keep it with new size.
tensor_stack: Stack multiple tensors into one output tensor (configurable number of inputs).
tensor_viz_scatter: Scatter plot of tensor 1 vs tensor 2 (both effectively 1D).
tinyshakespeare_lm_dataset: Real TinyShakespeare word-level next-token corpus. Download is required; this node never substitutes synthetic text.
tinystories_dataset: TinyStories-style sliding-window LM; synthetic prose or optional small text URL.
token_prediction_dataset: Random token sequences; choose retrieval by fixed position index or by nearest prior content to the last token.
trainer: Training loop: datasets, model, optimizer, loss, and observables.
training_visualization: Plots loss curves during and after training.
transformer_multi_token_model: K token ids per timestep [batch, L, K], fused per position, TransformerEncoder → last-timestep logits [batch, K, V]. For circular motion use K = 2.
transformer_token_model: Embedding + TransformerEncoder + lm_head on token ids [batch, T] → last-position logits [batch, V]; optional tied embedding / lm_head weights (GPT-style).
unembedding_layer: LM-head style torch.nn.Linear(d_model → vocab); pair after blocks that emit hidden activations.
unet_ddpm_model: Time-conditioned UNet noise predictor for CIFAR-10 image diffusion.
uniform_linear_motion_dataset: Physics toy dataset for x_{t+1}=2x_t-x_{t-1}: samples x0 and velocity, input is [x0, x1], target is x2.
url_node: Store a link; click the resolved URL below to open it in a new tab (http/https only).
vgg11_cifar_model: VGG-11 style stack for CIFAR-10 (32×32 RGB).
visualize_kan: Runs pykan KAN.plot() when wired to a KAN or checkpoint; optional dataset → train/test split sets sample count and input law.
vit_model: Tiny patch transformer for low-res grayscale; image size must divide patch size.
